caption: The drawing depicts a two-story house with a gabled roof, painted in light shades of purple with green window shutters. The house features a front porch with steps leading up to it and supporting columns, and latticework is visible on the side of the steps. There are multiple windows, each with shutters, distributed on both the first and second floors, as well as on the dormers in the roof. In front of the house, there is a fence with vertical rods, painted green with white posts, and a shrub or bush is situated to the left of the house. A tree with a brown trunk and green foliage partially obscures the house, with branches extending above the roof. Beyond the fence, a sidewalk runs parallel to the street, which is lightly colored in shades of beige and gray. Close to the sidewalk, a street lamp or post is visible. The sky and background are left mostly uncolored, with the focus on the house and front yard. The drawing style is loose, with watercolor washes, and there is a visible signature “G.E. COOK” in the lower right corner.
title: Old Dutch Farmhouse
